title: Flovr workflow
description: A workflow.yaml of Flovr: what starts it, its steps, what it answers and its tests. flovr validate checks more than this schema can, such as expressions and the files a step names.

flovr.description: The version of the file format. A file that leaves it out is in format 1.

name.description: The workflow's name, unique among the workflows a server serves.

steps.description: The steps, run in the order written.

tests.description: Each test runs the workflow with a fixture as the event that starts it, and compares what happened with expect.

trigger.description: What starts the workflow: exactly one of webhook, cron or manual.

webhook.description: A path that a POST request starts the workflow on.

cron.description: A schedule of five fields: minute hour day month weekday.

input.description: With webhook: a JSON Schema file the request body must match, or the request is refused.

id.description: Letters, digits and underscores, not starting with a digit.

value.description: Any value. A string may hold ${expression} placeholders, and a string that is one placeholder takes the value of the expression.

model.description: provider/model, where provider is anthropic, ollama, openai or openrouter, as in openrouter/deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash or ollama/llama3.2.

duration.description: A length of time, such as 30s, 2m or 1m30s.

when.description: The step runs only when this condition is true.

use.description: The folder of a component, relative to this file, or a component in git as host/owner/repo[/dir]@ref.

with.description: The values the component takes, by name.

timeout.description: How long each try of the step may take.

ai.description: Asks a model for an answer that fits a JSON Schema.

prompt.description: A file holding the system prompt.

input.description: What the model is given: text, or a value sent as JSON.

output.description: A JSON Schema file the answer must fit. Later steps read its fields.

decide.description: Asks a decision model typed questions. It answers with probabilities and writes no text.

question.description: A yes/no question, unless it has choice or score.

choice.description: The answers, each with what it means, as a mapping or a list.

score.description: The levels from lowest to highest, as a list.

http.description: Sends a request. Later steps read status and body.

retry.description: Try the step again after a failure: a number of tries after the first, or in full.

wait.description: Before the first try again, doubled for each one after; 1s if left out.

on.description: The failures to try again after; every one if left out.

respond.description: Makes the workflow an endpoint: the request waits and is answered with this.

fixture.description: A JSON file shaped like the event that starts the workflow, for a webhook {"body": {...}}.

expect.description: A step's id with called or skipped, or an expression with the value it should have, such as classify.category.value: refund.
